scope: Prelaunch review of four request-only Agent episodes; no scientific outcome claim
checks: Both arms have identical case request/task, common tools, backbone/high effort, ceilings, and zero prepared sources; only generic workflow policy differs. Ordinary Agent remains free to search, author, run, inspect and revise.

Requests contain population/schema/analyses and explicit eligibility only, with no source statistics, old candidates or reference values. New lipid request states positive BMI/TC/HDL and no TC-versus-HDL row exclusion.

Actual retrieval is Europe PMC search plus screened PMC article text/embedded tables. Supplement access is not advertised. Source choice is episode-local; alias screening precedes exposure; external text is marked untrusted.

Exact request bytes and conservative reservations are durable before one POST; max24 calls and USD4 per episode/USD16 global, no automatic retry. Unknown usage retains reservation. Output token cost includes reasoning; cached and cache-write categories are separated.
Stateless Responses preserves every output item, encrypted reasoning and matched function call outputs. Context and call journals are episode-local; only registered functions dispatch.

Interrupted HTTP/tools and escaped operational exceptions stop without duplicate dispatch or confirmed candidate selection. Explicit finalization is required; no latest/best candidate fallback. Secrets are not put in payloads and redaction precedes error truncation.

Candidate code is AST-checked but never host-imported. Execution uses unchanged WSL/bubblewrap worker with no host workspace/network/credentials/reference mount. Six attempted trials use only seed53001.

All four terminal episodes close before held-out seeds54001/54003/54007; exact12-slot matrix, candidate identities, canonical receipts and generated-file hashes are checked. Failed/absent outputs retain denominator slots and do not enter scientific means.

Cached final statistics must equal their bound execution receipts. The fixed trusted estimators are unchanged, and only after construction/final-table closure may the evaluator read the previously exposed aggregate snapshot.
resolved_prelaunch_findings: CLI uses PLAN episode queue order rather than sorted IDs.
Live gate requires reviewed file hashes to match the root launch freeze and actual bytes, including credential helper/external Python dependencies.
Declared supplement capability narrowed to actual article/embedded-table interface.
Exception redaction precedes slicing; uncertain runtime/persistence failures are terminal.
Pending failed sessions can close without reopening ToolRuntime; missing outputs keep all scheduled slots.
Evaluator enforces exact episode/seed/case/arm/candidate coverage and excludes failed statistics.
Evaluator checks canonical receipt/output paths, staged candidate binding, and exact slot status/statistics against the receipt.
Lipid strictly-positive output eligibility is disclosed equally in the research request.

independent_fixture_run.coverage: Actual loop + actual ToolRuntime with HTTP/credential/generator execution forbidden; policy/input equality; explicit earlier candidate; failed trial; exact reservation/cost/history; exclusion/URL boundary

implementation_owner_tests.basis: Owners reported passing focused suites; source fixtures reviewed. No historical suites rerun.

verification.initial_fixture_setup_issue: Default Windows pytest temp directory access denied before 3 fixtures; unit-local fresh fixture directory rerun passed. No production failure.
verification.runtime_inspection: Read-only runtime versions/file hashes; no independent generator execution.
verification.retrieval_probe: Root recorded successful nonclinical search and article full-text/index connectivity outside author episodes; no probe source supplied to authors.

documentation.use: Stateless reasoning and function-call items must be replayed; implementation includes encrypted_content and complete output history.

limitations: Two existing cases and one constructor per arm/case support feasibility/descriptive comparisons only; no general workflow superiority inference.
References were previously exposed at project level; fresh author contexts do not create independent clinical validation.
Retrieval scope is limited and conservative alias screening cannot prove no target-related or pretrained information.
Offline mocks verify mechanics, not scientific ability or successful live delivery. Actual captures, source admission and saved outputs still require postrun audit.
PLAN queue order does not guarantee HTTP start/completion counterbalancing under concurrency; actual timestamps must be reported.
